_about: Correctly typed notes that the whisper-tolerance rules once damaged (amounts read as clock times, 'and a 6 pack', titles like 'Get Out' split in two, 'before 2nd lesson', 'by three', past tense turned into to-dos, Title Case lowered, unrelated statements merged). Found by the 2026-09-23 adversarial review. Every case must stay exact.
_labels: Relabelled to the extraction conventions (ExtractionDefaults): tonight = 20:00, this evening = 18:00, in the morning = 09:00 (tomorrow once 09:00 has passed), a bare hour already past today rolls to tomorrow ('call Jasur at 8' said at 15:00 is 08:00 tomorrow). What each case guards is kept: '150 tonight' is not 01:50, 'Get Out' and 'Book Now' are not split, 'before 2nd lesson' is no date, 'by three'/'by four' is no time, names keep their capitals, an unrelated statement is not merged, 'and a 6 pack' is not split. Past-tense narration of done things ('Called the bank', 'Ordered the new phone') may stay a card, titled in the past tense as said, never rewritten into an order: whisper writes 'call the bank' as 'called the bank', and an extra card costs less than a lost task. A done thing on a day already gone ('Fixed the sink yesterday', 'Sent the contract this morning' said at 15:00) is no card.
